subject: Data-Driven Discovery of GSoC-R Projects - Mentors Needed.

messages.subject: Data-Driven Discovery of GSoC-R Projects - Mentors Needed.
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I am proposing a project for GSoC-R 2019: Data-Driven Discovery of GSoC-R projects

The idea is to update this list (make names complete and consistent):  https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/blob/master/projects.csv
And then, make a static dashboard web page out of it using available open source dashboard templates, and host it on GitHub.

The project hopes to present the past accomplishments of GSoC under R in a way that projects, students and mentors could easily be
discovered and numbers tracked for each year. Trends and insights through interactive visualizations are part of the scope.
Hoping this could help the R Foundation, org-admins and the R community in the long term track progress with GSoC-R.

The idea page for detailed explanation could be found here: https://github.com/benubah/gsoc-test/blob/master/gsoc_idea.md
Background work on this could be found here: https://benubah.github.io/rcentral/gsoc.html

The R org-admins are aware of this proposal.

I'm looking for mentors for this project. 

Would be delighted to hear from any interested mentors.

Thank you and best regards,
Benaiah Ubah
